_note: Constants of the annular throat kernel's application stages (a1_annular_kernel.py: chutkey, domain), kept as DATA with class and provenance per the validation numeric ratchet (R28); the verify stage's rungs are the carrier's birth literals.

chutkey_primary_arc_radius_m.note: Chutkey et al. 2014 p. 479: the primary nozzle's walls end in circular arcs of radius 0.867 mm at the throat (X1 in [-0.617, 0] mm), both walls (symmetric duct)

z_span.note: half-range of the stretched axial variable scanned for the sonic line: the series' own range (|z| ~ 1 = one throat-scale in x)

z_scan_points.note: resolution of the sonic-line scan in z (5e-4 x 1.5 of z, i.e. 1e-3 of the sonic line's span)

n_y_profile.note: points across the throat for the profiles and the convergence norms (the Chebyshev grid has 48; 41 samples resolve it)

n_y_mass.note: trapezoid points across the throat for the mass integral (1e-6 class on smooth profiles)

discharge_band.note: the transonic discharge coefficient of a smooth throat lies below the 1-D choked value and above 0.95 (Back et al. 1965, Kliegel-Levine 1969: 0.98-0.997 for R_c 0.6-2)

rc_ladder.note: the convergence map's rungs: Chutkey's 0.33, Dutton's tested 0.5 and 0.625 (Fig. 2-3: R_co 0.625) and 1.0 (Fig. 6-7), and two smooth throats

eta_ladder.note: the re-summation parameter around Dutton's recommended eta = 2

rc_converged_from.note: the domain gate: the series must converge (third term below the second, eta-spread within twice the third term) from this R_c up; measured 2026-09-21: ratio 0.63/0.71 at 1.0, marginal 0.8-0.9 at 0.5-0.625

axis_y_i.note: the axis limit posed as a centerbody of radius 1e-3 separations (D^2 = 2/(1 + y_i/y_o) converges to Sauer's 2 at O(y_i))

dutton_figures.note: Dutton & Addy 1982 figure captions: wall radii of curvature and y_i in units of the wall separation d (the kernel's units), beta in rad, eta 2 = their recommended third-order solutions; d_fig = d in the figures' unit (the outer wall's throat radius 25.4 mm): 1/R_co(fig) since R_co(fig) = 1.0 by construction (the digitised outer arcs fit radius 1.007/0.976/1.017); Z_star = the Z of the throat frame's origin on the axis (0 when beta = 0: the R axis passes through the outer wall's centre of curvature; for beta != 0 placed from the outer foot at Z = sin(beta) R_co(fig), declared)

dutton_z_window.note: the throat region compared (figure units): upstream of Z = -0.6 the wall is a 37.5 deg cone (p. 1242), the series is not posed there

dutton_levels.note: the iso-Mach levels drawn in Fig. 7-10

dutton_inlet_z.note: p. 1242: the series disagrees with the data 'in the throat inlet regions, particularly near the walls' where the wall contours transition (37.5 deg cone on the outer wall, cylindrical centerbody sections) -- the measured-field gates exclude Z below this (figure units); the series-vs-series gates keep every point

measured_class.note: 3 percent rms in Mach: their measurement class is +-1.3 percent at M 0.6 and +-0.6 at 1.4 (p. 1241) plus the digitisation (~0.01 in Z -> ~0.015 in M) and the inviscid-vs-viscous shift of the sonic line they report (data slightly downstream of the theory)

dutton_gamma.note: air, gamma 1.4 in every figure's label

digitisation_fig_units.note: the owner's digitisation of Dutton's figures: the wall profiles scatter 0.003-0.016 rms about the posed arcs (stage dutton prints them); 0.01 in Z, R is the class, converted to Mach with the local gradient of our field and widened by K_RICH

fd_step_fig_units.note: central-difference step for the Mach gradient at the digitised points (1e-3 of a figure unit, 1e-7 truncation on the analytic series)

zstar_search.note: registration scan of the inclined cases' frame origin about the posed outer-foot value: +-0.12 figure units in steps of 0.0025 (the digitisation class / 4)

wall_registration_window.note: the |Z| window (figure units) over which the digitised walls are compared with the posed parabolic arcs: inside the throat region, upstream of the cone/cylinder transitions

grid_margin.note: the Chebyshev grid extends 0.2 separations beyond each wall (half that on the inner side at most half the inner radius): the parabolic walls leave the throat section by x^2/(2 R_c) <= 0.1 at |z| <= 1 for R_c >= 1, and the series is analytic there
